passages.provision_quote: It is the policy of the state that eligible renewable energy resources and zero-carbon resources supply 90 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2035, 95 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2040, 100 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2045, and 100 percent of electricity procured to serve all state agencies by December 31, 2035.
passages.note: Author of SB 1020, which sets tiered RPS/zero-carbon procurement targets with firm deadlines ahead of the prior single 2045 deadline.

rows.reasoning: Laird authored SB 1020 (2021-2022), which amends Public Utilities Code Section 454.53 to require eligible renewable energy resources and zero-carbon resources supply 90 percent of retail electricity sales by December 31, 2035, 95 percent by 2040, and 100 percent by 2045 -- a renewable-procurement standard with dated targets matching rung 1's text, 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines.'
